results.final_response: I'm sorry for the inconvenience, but as a customer support agent, I don't have direct access to your order details. I would recommend you to log into your account on our website or app, and you should be able to view all the details of your orders, including order B1002. If you're having trouble accessing your account or finding the information, I'd be happy to guide you through the process.

Our return policy depends on the product you've purchased.

1. Books: We offer a 30-day return period for books, provided they are in new condition. Kindly note that you will bear the return shipping fees unless the return is due to a defect that was our fault.

2. E-books: Due to the digital nature of these goods, we typically do not accept returns for e-books unless there are technical difficulties or if the wrong book was sent.

3. Merchandise (like shirts, mugs, etc.): You can return these within a 14-day period, provided they are unused and in their original packing. 

In all cases, please reach out to our customer service before making a return so we can provide you with a Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) number. This will help us process your return more efficiently. 

Do keep in mind that it usually takes about 2-3 weeks from the time the item is posted, for the post to be returned to us, and for us to process the refund.

If you have any other questions or if there's a specific order you'd like to inquire about, feel free to ask!
